gloss: station passed without stopping; non-stop station

definitions.gloss: station passed without stopping; non-stop station
definitions.explanation: a train station that a particular service (typically express or limited express) passes through without making a stop

examples.japanese: この{駅|えき}は{急行|きゅうこう}の{通過駅|つうかえき}だ。
examples.english: This station is one that the express passes through.

examples.japanese: {通過駅|つうかえき}ではホームに{立|た}ち{入|い}らないでください。
examples.english: Please do not enter the platform at stations where the train passes through.

examples.japanese: {特急|とっきゅう}の{通過駅|つうかえき}に{住|す}んでいるので、{毎朝|まいあさ}{各停|かくてい}に{乗|の}り{換|か}えなければならない。
examples.english: I live at a station the limited express passes through, so I have to transfer to a local train every morning.

notes:
Combines {通過|つうか} (passing through) and {駅|えき} (station). A practical term for anyone using Japanese rail, where different service levels (local, rapid, express, limited express) stop at different stations. A {通過駅|つうかえき} for one service may be a regular stop for a slower service.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {急行|きゅうこう}の{通過駅|つうかえき}: express non-stop station
- {特急|とっきゅう}{通過駅|つうかえき}: limited express non-stop station
- {通過駅|つうかえき}を{確認|かくにん}する: to check which stations are skipped

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {停車駅|ていしゃえき}: stopping station — the opposite; a station where the train does stop
- {通過|つうか}: passing through — the general term for passing through without stopping
- {各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}: local train — a service that stops at every station
